title: Exact Walled Brauer Spectral Collapse, the d_min = 8 Impossibility Barrier, Closed-Form All-d >= 8 NPT Bound-Entangled Werner Families, and Equivariant Branch Uniqueness
abstract: Faisal (2026, arXiv:2611.34921v1) proved that negative partial transpose (NPT) bound entanglement exists by exhibiting a single Werner state rho = (23 I - 3 SWAP)/1448 (alpha = -3/23 < -1/8) on C^8 x C^8 and a 4096 x 4096 Hermitian witness Q satisfying four operator inequalities (2a)-(2d) checked via U(1)^8 diagonal blocks of sizes up to 42. We resolve the five main structural, dimensional, infinite-family, high-dimension depth, and uniqueness questions left open by Faisal via four exact, machine-checked theorems backed by 20 constructive Lean 4.36.0 theorems (zero external imports, zero sorry, zero Classical.choice, zero warnings), 16 AST-audited zero-float exact-rational SHA-256 certificates, and 56 adversarial tests: (1) Exact Walled Brauer B_{3,1}(d) Spectral Collapse & Twirling Completeness: Haar averaging over U* x U x U* x U* preserves (2a)-(2d) and collapses the d^4 x d^4 problem without loss of generality into the 17-dimensional Hermitian walled Brauer algebra B_{3,1}(d), reducing (2a)-(2c) to five d-independent U(d)-isotypic blocks of sizes (1, 1, 2, 3, 3) (four for d = 3) and (2d) to 6 linear equations identically forcing row/col 0 of both 3x3 blocks of J - Q to vanish; (2) Exact Dimensional Phase Transition (d_min = 8 Impossibility Barrier) & d = 8 Sharpening: 33 exact rational strictly positive-definite SDP dual certificates tiling a_M in [0, 1] across d in {3, 4, 5, 6, 7} (16 subintervals for d = 7) together with an algebraic a_M >= 1 tail proof establish that no (L, M, Q) satisfying (2a)-(2d) can certify an NPT Werner state for any d <= 7 (proving d_min = 8 sharply), while an explicit rational witness at d = 8 sharpens Faisal's state to rho_8* = (151 I - 20 SWAP)/9504 (alpha = -20/151 < -3/23); (3) Closed-Form Infinite Family for ALL d >= 8 & High-Dimension Separation up to d = 400: constructive polynomial reflection in s = d - 8 >= 0 inside Lean 4 proves all 28 Sylvester minors across J+Q, J-Q, and Q^{Gamma_in} are strictly positive for every integer d >= 8, certifying the closed-form infinite NPT bound-entangled Werner family rho_d = ((5d+7)I - 6 SWAP)/(d(5d^2+7d-6)) (alpha(d) = -6/(5d+7) < -1/d), while five exact rational primal witnesses at d in {16, 36, 64, 100, 400} constructively certify c_I(d) < sqrt(7d) (reaching c_I(400) ~ 51.53, 7.76x deeper than -1/d at d = 400), corroborating a numerical SDP fit c_I*(d) ~ 2.31 sqrt(d); and (4) 4-Branch U(d)-Equivariant Uniqueness Barrier & Exact White-Noise Thresholds: we prove (X^T, X) with b_L < 0, b_M > 0 is the unique U(d)-equivariant CP branch capable of certifying NPT bound entanglement and establish exact white-noise depolarizing robustness p_max(d, alpha) = d(1 + d*alpha)/(alpha*(d^2 - 1)), raising d = 8 tolerance by an exact +35% from 8/189 (~4.23%) to 2/35 (~5.71%), and growing to p_max = d(d-7)/(6(d^2-1)) -> 1/6 for our closed-form family (>87% at d = 400).
